blind.B1: Not an exercise question: miR-501 MP-specific KO (Pax7Cre vs miR-501dMP) TA at day 6 after cardiotoxin injury. Paper has an eccentric exercise method (S2.5) but GEO metadata have no exercise arm (no exercise words). Genotype is the factor; all 10 samples are CTX-regenerating muscle. Not an exercise series.
blind.B2: Pax7Cre control (n=5) vs miR-501dMP KO (n=5), TA day 6 post CTX (Fig 3e legend, S3.3 results: 89 down, 146 up, p<0.05).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one TA RNA-seq per mouse, titles 'mouse 1-5' per genotype; the title suffix is not a shared animal (different mice per genotype).
blind.B4: Paper does not describe the bulk RNA-seq statistical model (S2.18 only covers alignment and Enrichr); a two-group comparison.
blind.B5: Results S3.3 / Fig 3e: 89 genes significantly down and 146 up in miR-501dMP vs control at p<0.05 (raw p, no stated FDR or fold-change cutoff); no method named.

checks.evidence: Metadata have no exercise words; all 10 samples CTX day 6, genotype only (packet A); exercise in S2.5 was histology only (Evans blue).
No analysis run; planned WT5/KO5 matches Fig 3e n=5.
One TA per mouse; title-suffix key not supported by expression check (r diff 0.096, p=0.27); no repeated measures.
Paper silent on the bulk model; nothing fitted.
No analysis; single sex, one time point.
Integer featureCounts counts, matching GEO data_processing and S2.18.
Recorded as raw p<0.05, no FC cutoff, matching S3.3 (89 down/146 up).
HANDBACK states 0 vs paper, genotype contrast not run; no overclaim.
Claim 'no exercise arm' checked against exercise-word columns (none), metadata levels and paper; true for the sequenced samples.

human_items: Policy question (open): whether the genotype contrast (miR-501dMP vs Pax7Cre, paper's own DEG comparison) should still be run as a labelled non-exercise reference; refusal is consistent with the current rule.
summary: 本系列10个样本均为CTX损伤后第6天的胫骨前肌，只有基因型因素，没有运动组，拒绝运行的理由成立。论文的运动实验仅做了组织学，未测序。各项检查均无分歧，总体通过。
